name: Bookshelf-Traveller
description: A simple discord bot that allows you to listen to your audiobooks and manage your audiobookshelf (ABS) server. For the full guide, please visit the bookshelf-traveller repository.

paths.name: Persistant DB
paths.description: Path for db(s) to stay persistant. Delete if you want the docker to re-initialize the dbs everytime it starts up.

variables.name: Client ID
variables.description: Discord application client ID. This can be found under the 'OAuth2' tab in the discord dev portal.

variables.name: Bookshelf Token
variables.description: ABS Token, generated in the settings page of the user. Accepts all user types, but will have limitations if not admin.

variables.name: Owner Only
variables.description: Only the owner will have access to all commands. Disable to allow others to use the bot.

variables.name: Enable Audio Playback
variables.description: By default is true, enables the audio module. If disabled, it will remove the ability for audio playback.

variables.name: Default Search Provider
variables.description: Default search provider for titles. Please refer to ABS API wiki page for full list. EXPERIMENTAL AND OPTIONAL

variables.name: Enable Audio Playback
variables.description: By default is true, enables the audio module. If disabled, it will remove the ability for audio playback.

variables.name: Playback Role
variables.description: Playback Role. Can be copied over from discord when developer mode is enabled.

variables.name: Multi-User
variables.description: Enables multi-user login to ABS server. Disable to allow admin controls.

variables.name: HTTPS Image URL
variables.description: Used if you want to use HTTPS connection to retrieve your images. Note this won't do anything if you are already using it in the primary URL.

variables.name: Debug Mode
variables.description: Will make log verbose and show all internal library logs as well.
